notes: Florida only (queue line US - Florida). No official FVMA directory or statewide duty rota was found/opened; clinics' own pages used. Not 24 h by conservative rule: VEC Central Florida (page says 'around the clock'), Sarasota, Naples, Bradenton, Pensacola (inconsistent hours), UF WEC Ocala. Left out (no address/phone on opened page or page not fetchable): Thrive Miami, Thrive Largo (Tampa Bay Veterinary Specialists), Dixie Animal Hospital Miami (no address), Florida Pets and Vets Orlando (no address), pet911vet.com Orlando and Keys Animal ER (fetch failed/robots), Concierge Vet Naples (not 24 h), Epic St. Petersburg, other Manatee clinics without hours, 24/7 Animal Hospital of Orlando and Collier Animal Referral not opened. Other US states are separate queue lines.
